trigger: My property is being demolished or seized
description: What to do if authorities try to seize or demolish your property.

steps.text: Stay calm and do not obstruct, but do not consent to the action.
Ask to see any court order or lawful authority for the demolition or seizure.
Your property cannot be compulsorily taken without due process and compensation (s.44).
You are entitled to a fair hearing before your rights are decided (s.36(1)).
Take photos and video if it is safe; note names, agencies, and the time.
Keep your title documents, receipts, and any notices safe.
Call a lawyer or Legal Aid urgently.
